title: Meguiar's Sturdy Finish Restoration Kit - Includes a Cleaning Solution to deep Clean the Plastic and Protective Trim and Protector that Provides Ultra-Durable Protection with
description: With time and exposure to the sun and elements, the exterior plastic finish can start to fade and lose its shine, making a relatively new vehicle look much older than it really is. Fortunately, Meguiar's has the sturdy finish restoration kit. This three-part kit includes a cleaning solution, finishing protector and finish protection applicator pad. This car cleaning kit allows anyone to restore the faded finish and leave behind durable protection that gives the automotive finish a wealth and depth that last and last in two simple steps. The first step uses the included cleaning solution to remove incorporated contamination and oxidation and thoroughly cleans the black and gray finish to maximize binding and durability of the trim protector. Finished protector restores the look of the finished pieces and leaves behind ultra durable protection. It features UV blocking protection and offers over 250 wash durability*. A finishing applicator is included in this car detail kit to help ensure a uniform application for the best performance of the finish sealant. Don't let the faded finish make your ride look bad and neglected. The heavy-duty finish restoration kit will restore the nasty, faded finish of the car, leaving behind the protection and durability you expect from Meguiar. *Based on automated lab cleaning testing.
